interpretation: Horizon scanning is linked to execution at infrastructure scale.

interpretation: The energy-transition narrative has measurable operating and emissions anchors, though safety remains a major unresolved tension.

outcome_anchor: Chevron reports best-ever free cash flow, Noble integration completion, dividend increase, and reinstated share repurchases while launching lower-carbon priorities.
interpretation: Lower-carbon renewal is explicitly tied to exploitation of financial and operational strength.
